findings.rule: AGENTS.md Motion / testability of W4 screens: infinite loops must honour InfiniteAnimationPolicy
findings.trigger: The idle loop is `while (true) withFrameNanos {}`. Under Robolectric, ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE is 1, so TmrTheme provides Default motion. Any compose test that uses autoAdvance (the default), for example a W4 screen test that renders TmrTheme { TmrPaige(Home) }, then never idles: ComposeIdlingResource pumps frames while clock.hasAwaiters (ui-test 1.10 ComposeIdlingResource.android.kt:68-74). setContent/onNode then time out. The PR's own tests avoid this only by setting autoAdvance=false. Fix: use withInfiniteAnimationFrameNanos, which the test InfiniteAnimationPolicy cancels when autoAdvance is on.
findings.title: Paige frame loop never lets Compose tests idle
findings.proof: rule.setContent { TmrTheme { TmrPaige(TmrPaigePose.Home) } }; rule.onRoot().assertExists() with default autoAdvance times out on head and passes with withInfiniteAnimationFrameNanos.

findings.rule: PRD 10.5 (48 dp minimum touch target, TalkBack labels); review ask: >= 48 dp targets and labels
findings.trigger: TmrToggle(checked=false, onCheckedChange={}) puts toggleable on a 52x32 dp box, so the touch target is 32 dp tall. The API takes no label, so TalkBack announces only 'Switch, off'. The prototype (Prototype.dc.html:835) makes the whole 52 px labelled row the button. A caller that wraps the toggle in a toggleable row gets two focus stops, because onCheckedChange is non-null. Fix: add a label and make the row toggleable, or make onCheckedChange nullable and apply minimumInteractiveComponentSize.
findings.title: Toggle target is 32 dp tall and has no accessible name

findings.rule: PRD 10.5 dynamic text size; review ask: no clipping at font scale 2.0
findings.trigger: At font scale 2.0, the 28 sp Space Mono headline is 56 sp, about 31.6 dp per glyph. On the 374 dp prototype device the text width is about 298 dp, so about 9 glyphs fit per line. 'Tell Paige about you' then wraps to 'Tell / Paige / about you' and maxLines=2 ellipsizes it to 'Tell Paige…'. Half the headline is lost. The plan's 'max 2 lines' fits only at 1.0. There is no hero_card font-200 baseline.
findings.title: Hero headline truncates at font scale 2.0
findings.proof: Render the hero_card at TmrTestDevices.prototypeLargeFont and assert the headline TextLayoutResult.hasVisualOverflow is false. It fails on head.

findings.rule: Plan scale contract: O(1) work per frame only where motion exists
findings.trigger: TmrPaige(Fail) or TmrPaige(Delete) under Default motion: the spec has no bobPhase and no wobble, so both transforms are always 0. The LaunchedEffect still writes the time state on every vsync, which re-runs the layer block and keeps the Choreographer awake for as long as the sad Paige is on screen.
findings.title: Frame loop runs for poses that never move

findings.rule: Fidelity: pill and rounded shapes (README Look)
findings.trigger: The Material3 ripple (LocalIndication) is bounded to the layout rectangle, not to the shape. Pressing TmrPrimaryButton, TmrSecondaryButton, TmrChoiceRow, TmrUploadCard or TmrToggle therefore paints square corners outside the pill or rounded background. The legacy Button.kt uses Surface(shape), which clips. Fix: add .clip(shape) before clickable/selectable/toggleable.
findings.title: Press ripple is not clipped to the pill or rounded shape

findings.trigger: Paige.dc.html uses CSS content-box with no box-sizing reset in support.js, so bordered parts are larger than their width/height values. Arms are 22 + 5 = 27 px (Compose draws 22 dp). The fold is 32.5 px (Compose 30 dp). The happy mouth is mw + 5 by mh + 2.5 (Compose mw by mh). The sad mouth is 25 by 12.5 (Compose 20 by 10). The arms are about 20% smaller than the prototype.
findings.title: Bordered Paige parts are drawn with border-box sizes
